title: Simultaneous A/B + Shadow Orbit with Rollback Simulator and Explainable Decisions
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Adds a simulator-backed rollout mode that runs A/B splits alongside shadow mirroring, introduces explainable decision logs for automated rollback recommendations, and exposes a new telemetry view in the Console to replay simulated cutovers.
description:
Context and motivation: We’ve seen recurring operational churn when teams try to run simultaneous A/B experiments while seeding shadow traffic for candidate models. Manual coordination between the two planes leads to either overexposure (user surprise) or under-observability for rollback decisions. This PR introduces a unified runtime concept — the 'orbit' — that can run an A/B split in active lanes while mirroring shadow traffic into candidate lane(s) and using a deterministic rollback simulator to validate rollback decisions before they are applied live.

Summary of changes: Adds an orbit controller that coordinates: (1) probabilistic annealing of A/B weights, (2) shadow mirroring with session-coherent sampling, (3) a rollback simulation harness that replays recent traffic slices against candidate model variants to estimate rollback impact, and (4) explainable decision logging that attaches the top causal signals used by the simulator to each rollback recommendation. The PR also wires a new Console page (Telemetry -> Orbit Simulator) and exposes a gRPC endpoint on the operator for dry-run simulations.

Commits (high-level): commit 1: controller: implement orbit finite-state machine and weight annealer; commit 2: simulator: playback harness + deterministic sampling; commit 3: mirror: session-sticky shadow router and kv-cache isolation; commit 4: observability: telemetry view, decision log schema, new metrics (orbit_rollbacks_total, orbit_simulation_score); commit 5: tests: unit + integration harness + canary e2e; commit 6: docs: Console and runbook updates; commit 7: small fixes from reviewer feedback.

Files changed (high level): src/rollout/orbit_controller.go, src/rollout/simulator/playback.go, src/rollout/router/shadow_router.go, src/console/pages/orbit_simulator.tsx, pkg/telemetry/orbit_logs.pb.go, deploy/operator/api.proto, tests/integration/orbit_e2e_test.go, docs/runbooks/orbit-runbook.md (plus ancillary CI and test fixtures).

Design notes / important behaviors: - Rollback simulator replays a bounded, recent traffic window (configurable; default 30m) and computes a probabilistic rollback score using weighted SLO regressions and output divergence. - Decisions are annotated with the top three contributing signals (latency percentile shifts, per-cohort correctness delta, and distributional token divergence) so SREs can quickly reason about automated recommendations. - Session-coherent shadowing ensures user session stickiness is preserved across active and shadow lanes to avoid noisy signal mixing. - The operator exposes a dry-run endpoint so teams can run the simulator against arbitrary historical slices without impacting live traffic.

Testing and perf: Unit coverage added for the orbit FSM and shadow router (approx 82%). Integrated simulator benchmarks run on the perf-lab: single 1M-request replay completes in ~7s with deterministic sampling; the end-to-end canary e2e with low-volume live canary completed in staging. Load tests show <3% p99 latency delta on the control lane when mirroring at 2x sampling rate due to asynchronous mirror IO and isolated KV cache.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind runtime flag ENABLE_ORBIT; initial rollout to dedicated staging clusters for two weeks, then opt-in beta customers via Dedicated. Console feature will be behind feature flag in the UI.

Review conversation (summary): Priya: "The simulator is promising, but we need clearer bounds on false positives for rollback recommendations and a knob to control conservatism." — Author reply: "Added a conservatism coefficient (simulator.conservatism_alpha) with default 0.6 and documented tradeoffs in the runbook."

Jared: "Concern about stateful session stickiness across mirrors — is session kv cache race-free when mirroring at high fanout?" — Author reply: "Session KV is now copied atomically to a shadow namespace; added a unit test and doc comment. See commit 4 for details."

Evan: "Please add an integration smoke test that exercises dry-run gRPC against a recorded slice." — Author reply: "Added tests/integration/orbit_e2e_test.go and a small recorded fixture. CI now runs the smoke test in the integration matrix.",

manual_steps: To enable in Dedicated clusters: set ENABLE_ORBIT=true in operator config, configure simulator.replay_window and conservatism_alpha, and opt-in Console feature flag. See docs/runbooks/orbit-runbook.md for step-by-step and rollback playbook.

backport_plan: No backport to release/* planned; operator API change will be included in next minor if requested.
